description: Reads the objects and parts from a Bambu project 3MF, including each part's subtype and per-part settings. Use it to verify that what was written is really in the file; this is the key advantage of working with files over the GUI: you can compare item by item instead of only looking at the screen. It also flags subtypes that BambuStudio does not recognise. No side effects.
name: bambu_inspect_project
title: Read back the part structure of a 3MF
